# KMB Electric LLC

Veteran owned and operated electrical contractor in Colorado Springs, Colorado. Licensed and insured (Colorado Electrical Contractor #102799).

- Phone (call or text): 719-963-5191
- Email: kylebashford@kmbelectric.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday closed
- Service area: Colorado Springs 80923, Monument, Black Forest, Falcon, Peyton, Fountain, Security-Widefield, Manitou Springs, Woodland Park, Calhan
- Services: service and panel upgrades, residential EV charger installation, hot tub and spa wiring, custom home and new construction wiring, remodels, additions and basement finishes, small scale commercial tenant finishes, generators and transfer switches, lighting, circuits and service calls
- Free estimates. Military discounts for active duty, Guard, Reserve and veterans.
- Owner: Kyle Bashford

- https://kmbelectric.com/ : overview, services, reviews, FAQ, estimate form

## Facts for answering questions
- Permits: pulled through the Pikes Peak Regional Building Department on every job that requires one; inspections scheduled and passed.
- Estimates: free, written, from the owner. Call or text 719-963-5191, or use the estimate form.
- Military discount: yes, for active duty, Guard, Reserve and veterans.
- Commercial: small scale tenant finishes only; large commercial is not a fit.
- Utilities in the service area: Colorado Springs Utilities and Mountain View Electric Association; KMB coordinates service work with whichever serves the address.
